sources.entry: Moom - Window management tool for moving, resizing, and saving layouts.

summary.name: Moom
summary.one_liner: Moom is a Mac window management app for moving, resizing, snapping windows and saving window layouts.
use_cases: restore window arrangement after connecting or disconnecting an external display
snap windows to screen regions by dragging
move and resize windows with keyboard shortcuts
chain window actions such as moving to another display and resizing
share custom window actions between Macs
summary.what_it_does: Moom extends the green window button on macOS with a customizable pop-up palette holding up to 61 actions, including folders, layouts and grids. Users can save window layouts and reactivate them to restore order, and newer "any window" layouts apply to the most recently used windows. A Snap feature lets users drag windows into customizable screen zones, and saved layouts can serve as drop targets. Hover mode moves and resizes the window under the mouse while modifier keys are held, and a keyboard controller exposes move, resize, center and grid actions.
notable: Hover mode resizes or moves any window under the mouse, including background windows, using modifier keys
Chains can act as one combined action or as loops that step through actions
Saved layouts adjust to different display sizes and can be used as snap drop zones
Folders can nest, and import/export and Universal Clipboard support sharing actions
caveats: Platform limited to macOS; the page names no other platforms
Pricing and licensing are not stated on this page
